caption: The drawing features a central, detailed illustration of a green, hexagonal-patterned handbag with a decorative net overlay. The bag is adorned with clusters of small, colored flowers in blue, pink, and purple, as well as round brown elements. The net overlay is tied with green string and features gold tassels at each corner and the center, as well as on the braided green-and-gold handles. Above the bag and to the right, there is a simple line drawing of the handbag's outline and handle, showing the basic shape. At the bottom left, there is another line drawing that shows the structure and pattern of the bag from a slightly different angle, focusing on the net design and fringe detail. The artist’s signature, “Hugh Clarke,” is in the lower right corner of the page. The drawing is rendered on an off-white or beige background.
title: Silk Purse
